question.question:
D3 — Want outside design voices before the detailed review?
Project/branch/task: main, User Dashboard Page plan, Variant A approved as reference.
ELI10: Two independent second opinions before I run the 7 passes. Codex (OpenAI's CLI) grades the plan against a set of hard design rules and 7 litmus checks; a fresh Claude subagent that hasn't seen my notes does an independent completeness review. Where they agree with me, we move faster; where they disagree, you see both sides.
Stakes if we pick wrong: skipping means findings rest on one reviewer's taste; running costs a few minutes and Codex may be unavailable in this environment.
Recommendation: A because independent voices catch blind spots and the cost is a few minutes.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: a few minutes for cross-model confidence vs. a faster single-voice review.

options.label: Yes, run outside design voices (recommended)
options.description: ✅ Codex hard-rule + litmus scorecard plus an independent Claude completeness read. ✅ Disagreements surface with both perspectives in the relevant pass. ❌ Adds a few minutes; Codex may be missing here, in which case only the Claude voice runs and it's tagged single-model.

options.label: No, proceed without
options.description: ✅ Straight into the 7 passes with the approved mockup as anchor. ✅ Fewest steps to a fixed plan. ❌ Findings rest on one reviewer; no cross-model check on slop risk or hierarchy.
